cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tournament is over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then the documentary opens next season.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our team is disbanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A reunion comeback. You've just improved the second act.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tournament is over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the documentary opens next season.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our team is disbanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A reunion comeback. You've just improved the second act.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've burned the oven out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The competition's tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?
